newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates unchanged in slow market.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates unchanged in slow market.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed unchanged on Monday amid sluggish demand, brokers said.
Broker Adil Nasim at the private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said mills were not buying in big lots due to interest rates of at least 22 percent on cotton purchased on credit.
Apart from a few big mills, others were buying only to meet their daily needs, Nasim said.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 was quoted at 2,275 to 2,350 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), depending on quality, he said.
